summary: Page-turn book that works unchanged as UI or as a 3D world-space object.
overview: A book you can turn the pages of, by button or by dragging a corner. The same controller drives a Canvas book and a real 3D one without changing, because it only ever talks to its surfaces through two small interfaces — so the curl maths, the drag handling and the page list are written once and the rendering is swapped.

features.name: Book controller
features.what: owns the page list, the current spread and the turn, by button or drag.

features.name: Curl surface
features.what: the one animated page being turned, reused for both directions.

features.name: Backing surfaces
features.what: the flat left and right pages of the current spread.

features.name: Canvas and World variants
features.what: the same setup rendered as a UI Graphic or as a real procedural mesh.

useCases: An in-game book, journal or codex with real page turns.
A photo album or recipe book on a kiosk or tablet build.
A 3D book prop the player can pick up and leaf through.

walkthrough.name: Pages
walkthrough.what: The page textures in order. currentPageIndex starts pointing at the first spread.

walkthrough.name: Left / Right backing
walkthrough.what: The two static pages of the current spread. These never animate.

walkthrough.name: Curl surface
walkthrough.what: The ONE page that animates, reused for turns in both directions rather than one per side.

walkthrough.name: Hinge anchor
walkthrough.what: Marks the spine's position and rotation, which is what the curl bends around.

walkthrough.name: Flip duration
walkthrough.what: Length of a button-driven turn. Drag-driven turns follow the finger instead.

walkthrough.name: Drag commit threshold
walkthrough.what: How far through the turn (0-1) a drag must get before releasing completes it rather than snapping back.

gotchas.title: One curl surface, not one per side
gotchas.body: The same overlay is reused for forward and backward turns. Duplicating it per direction is the common mis-setup and leaves a stale page visible.

gotchas.title: Pages are textures, with no separate front and back art
gotchas.body: Deliberately texture-only. A page showing different art on its reverse is two entries in the list, not one page with two sides.

gotchas.title: The 3D drag handler needs a collider, the UI one needs a RectTransform
gotchas.body: They are different components for that reason. Mixing them up means drags simply never register.
